subject: Need help using analysis engine as stand alone to conduct

messages.author: 73b62f7cf4931a76
messages.subject: Need help using analysis engine as stand alone to conduct
parts:
Greetings all-

I'm hoping someone has successfully used another program (I'm thinking
of using R, possibly VBA?) to call the MCDS or earlier versions of the
Distance analysis engine in order to run 1000's of simulations,
bootstraps, etc. I've been through the List archive and seen a couple
suggestive posts, but nothing to imply that these have been brought to
fruition.

We'd like to look at the (admittedly retrospective) effects of
different study designs on estimates of annual bird density. To start,
we hope to look at the effect of number of survey visits within a
breeding season (up to 5 at a given study site) and number of point
transect sub-samples (up to 10 at a given study site) on our annual
density estimates. I suspect someone has already accomplished much of
this, but if not I'll ask around for a proper programmer.

Any thoughts? Thanks in advance

-Russ
